title: Having things done
goal: Say who you got to do something, and talk about having things done.

intro.text: With a verb that has no object, the person made to act takes the accusative: *Çagany güldürdim*. With a verb that has an object, the thing keeps the accusative and the person takes the dative: *Kakama kitap aldyrdym*, I had my dad buy a book. With no person: *Saçymy kesdirdim*, I had my hair cut.

vocab.en: to sew (tikdirmek: to have something made, sewn)
to raise (a hand); to leave (something) behind

exercises.question: *Men çagany güldürdim.* Who laughed?

why.1: *Men* made it happen. The one who laughed is the object, *çagany*.
why.2: Only the child laughed; I made it happen.

exercises.explain: *Gülmek* has no object, so the person made to laugh takes the accusative: *çagany*.

exercises.en: I had my dad buy a book.

reject.why: *Almak* already has its object, *kitap*. The person you get to buy it takes the dative: *kakama*.
*Kakam* would make your dad the subject. The person you get to do it takes the dative: *kakama*.

exercises.prompt: I had my hair cut yesterday.

reject.why: *Kesdim* says you cut it yourself. Having it cut is the causative: *kesdirdim*.

exercises.explain: *kes-* + *-dir* + *-di* + *-m*: I had it cut. Who cut it isn't named.

exercises.question: How do you say **I had my car repaired**?

why.2: After a stem of two syllables that ends in *r*, the causative is *-t*: *bejertdim*.

exercises.prompt: She put a new dress on her daughter.

reject.why: *Geýmek* already has its object, *köýnek*. The person dressed takes the dative: *gyzyna*.

exercises.explain: *geý-* + *-dir*: to make wear, to dress. The thing put on is the object; the daughter takes the dative.

exercises.label: *kesdirmek* (to have something cut), past: I had it cut, you had it cut…
exercises.explain: A causative is a verb like any other: *kesdir-* + the past *-di* and its endings.

accept: I left the book at home.
I have left the book at home
I left my book at home

exercises.prompt: I had a photo taken for my passport.

exercises.question: What did Myrat do today?

context.tk: Bu gün köp iş etdim: maşynymy ýuwdurdym, telefonymy bejertdim, saçymy hem kesdirdim.

options: He had his car washed, his phone repaired and his hair cut.
He washed his car and repaired his phone himself.

why.1: *Ýuwdurdym* and *bejertdim* are causative: someone else did the work.
why.2: *Kesdirdim* is causative: someone else cut it.

exercises.explain: All three verbs are causative: *ýuwdurdym, bejertdim, kesdirdim*. Myrat had them done.

exercises.prompt: Dad made me wash the car.

reject.why: *Ýuwmak* already has its object, *maşyny*. The person made to wash it takes the dative: *maňa*.

exercises.explain: *ýuw-* + *-dur*: make wash. The car keeps the accusative; *maňa* is the one made to do it.
